# `armadad user`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Recover a user's credentials on a server.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armadad user renew`](#armadad-user-renew) | Renew a user certificate with the cluster CA on this server |

## `armadad user renew`

Get a new one-year certificate for a new key, under the same name, signed
by the cluster CA in the data directory, and rewrite the client config
(--config, default ~/.armada/config, else /etc/armada/admin.config; another
user's config stays theirs, a shared one stays shared).
For a certificate that has already expired; while it is valid,
`armada rbac user renew` does the same through the control plane.
The user keeps the roles on record (cluster-admin for one the cluster
has no record of).

```
armadad user renew [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | server data directory holding the cluster CA (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
